name: Really Simple Login Logo
author: CRFTD

sections.description:
Really Simple Login Logo is a lightweight plugin that allows you to easily customize your WordPress login page logo. It provides a simple, intuitive interface in the WordPress admin area to select and manage your custom login logo.

No upsells. No dashboard advertising. No bloat. Just keeping it simple.

This plugin was developed specifically with freelancers, agencies, and users who have a desire to remove the default WordPress logo and set their own. No custom uploads by file managers or FTP clients, no need for page builder templates. This plugin is meant to be super simple. Upload an image from your device or select one from the WordPress Media Library. Then save. No bloated options. No hoops to jump through or URL changes. Just set and forget. Simply brand the login page for your client or agency.

Key Features

  • Simple and intuitive admin interface
  • WordPress Media Library integration
  • Support for multiple image formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF)
  • Secure file handling
  • No unnecessary options or settings
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Mobile-friendly
  • Translation ready

Why Choose Really Simple Login Logo?

  • Super Simple: No complex settings or confusing options
  • Lightweight: Minimal code footprint, no unnecessary features
  • Well Maintained: Regular updates and security patches
  • WordPress Standards: Follows WordPress coding standards and best practices

What’s Next

If you like this plugin, consider checking out our other plugins:

  • Divi Slider Accessibility – A Divi accessibility script that fixes WCAG compliance with slider navigation controls.
  • GF Choice Converter – Bulk Convert Gravity Forms Choice Fields.
  • WordPress Login Screen – Page builder agnostic WordPress Login Screen customization.

Notes

Really Simple Login Logo is the most simple and user-friendly WordPress custom login logo plugin available.

Hey, I’m Brandon, the founder of Really Simple Plugins and CRFTD Web Development. We build simple and lightweight tools for developers, freelancers, and marketing agencies as well as WordPress sites.

This plugin was meant to be as lightweight and maintainable as possible, no ads or upsells, with this being the only message you see from me outside of updates.

I hope you like the plugin.

Thank you,

Brandon Crabtree

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect any personal data. It only stores the URL of your selected logo in the WordPress options table.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the really-simple-login-logo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Login Logo to configure your custom logo
  4. Select your logo from the Media Library
  5. Save your changes
  6. Visit your login page to see the new logo

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Administrator access to WordPress
sections.faq:
What image formats are supported?

The plugin supports the following image formats:
* JPEG/JPG
* PNG
* GIF
* WebP
* AVIF

What can you do with this plugin?

You can literally only change the WordPress login logo. Nothing more.

Is there a file size limit?

Yes, the maximum file size is 5MB. This is to ensure optimal performance and security.

Can I use any image from my Media Library?

Yes, you can use any image from your WordPress Media Library that meets the format and size requirements.

Will this affect my site’s performance?

No, the plugin is designed to be lightweight and has minimal impact on your site’s performance.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation-ready and includes a .pot file for translators.

Can I preview the login page before saving?

Yes, once you’ve selected a logo, you can use the “Preview Login Page” button to see how it looks.

What user roles can change this?

Only accounts with administrative capabilities can change the logo.

Hold up, we need more customization. What are my options?

With this plugin, none. It’s the login logo only. You can check our website. We have a login screen customizer that’s super lightweight. It’s paid, though. There are also a few other tools for Gravity Forms and Divi.
